about_the_game:
Help Magnolia find her friend Ruth. Explore cozy corners, get to know the surroundings through the main character's thoughts, and fill her album with cute sketches.

"Magnolia and Ruth: Hide-and-Seek" is a short but atmospheric game, created for players who appreciate cozy worlds, simple stories, and attention to detail. It's the perfect way to spend a quiet evening.

Game Features:

  • Dynamic Hiding Spots: Each time you start the game, Ruth hides in a new place, adding an element of surprise.

  • Exploration Through Thoughts: Click on objects to find out what Magnolia thinks about them. These bits of information reveal her character and the history of the world around her.

  • Sketch Album: Collect drawings by finding and interacting with new objects. Try to find them all!

  • Leisurely Gameplay: No stress or timers. Just a slow-paced and pleasant exploration designed for relaxation.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5—11600K / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 12GB / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT 12GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Help Magnolia find her friend Ruth in this cozy, atmospheric game. Explore the world through her thoughts, fill a sketchbook, and enjoy relaxed, timer-free gameplay. Ruth's hiding spot changes every time, making each playthrough unique. Perfect for a quiet evening.
